name: Soma VR
storyline: The radio is dead, food is running out, and the machines have started to think they are people. Underwater facility PATHOS-II has suffered an intolerable isolation and we’re going to have to make some tough decisions. What can be done? What makes sense? What is left to fight for?
summary: A native VR mod by Bateau1 for SOMA, an award-winning video game created by Frictional Games, using its existing HPL3 engine. It has 6DoF motion controls, full finger-tracking (with compatible controllers), and hands which change dynamically with progress in the story.
